福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

國立臺灣文學館National Museum of Taiwan Literature

認識森山松之助設計的臺南州廳，它如何熬過戰火、當過空軍與市政府，最後變成收藏多語臺灣文學的國家文學館。

Learn how the Tainan Prefecture Hall survived war, served the Air Force and the city, and became a home for Taiwan literature.

臺南市中心的大圓環旁，有一座綠圓頂的紅磚大廳，如今是臺灣文學的家。建築師森山松之助設計，1916 年辦公室遷入；1920 年成為臺南州廳。它有法式馬薩屋頂、圓頂衛塔，還有三根一組的塔斯干柱。1945 年 3 月 1 日炸彈燒毀屋頂；後來空軍進駐，1969 年起當了 28 年臺南市政府。1997 年開始修復，馬薩屋頂重現，舊州廳後方加了一棟較矮的新建築。2003 年 10 月 17 日開館，收藏從原住民族故事到臺語、客語、日文、華語的作品。

By the big roundabout in central Tainan stands a red-brick hall with green domes, now a home for Taiwan literature. Architect Moriyama Matsunosuke designed it, and in 1916 the offices moved in. It became the Tainan Prefecture Hall in 1920. It wore a French-style Mansard roof, domed guard towers, and Tuscan columns standing in groups of three. On March 1, 1945, bombs burned the roof. Later the Air Force moved in, and from 1969 it was Tainan City Hall for 28 years. Restoration began in 1997. The Mansard roof came back, and a lower new building was added behind the old hall. On October 17, 2003, it opened as a museum for Taiwan literature, from Indigenous stories to poems in Taiwanese, Hakka, Japanese and Mandarin.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

這棟紅磚綠頂的建築原是日治時期的臺南州廳，經歷空襲、空軍與市政府進駐，如今是臺灣第一座國家級文學博物館，收藏用原住民族語、臺語、客語、日文和華語寫成的臺灣文學。

This red-brick hall with green domes was built as the Tainan Prefecture Hall. It survived an air raid and served the air force and the city government. Today it is Taiwan's first national museum of literature, holding works in Indigenous languages, Taiwanese, Hakka, Japanese and Mandarin.

  1. 1916森山松之助設計的廳舍落成，辦公室遷入。The building by Moriyama Matsunosuke is finished and offices move in.
  2. 1920成為臺南州廳。It becomes the Tainan Prefecture Hall.
  3. 19453 月 1 日空襲，屋頂燒毀。On 1 March an air raid burns the roof.
  4. 1949–1997空軍進駐，1969 年起由臺南市政府使用 28 年。The air force moves in; from 1969 the city government uses it for 28 years.
  5. 200310 月 17 日以國立臺灣文學館開館，同年升格國定古蹟。Opens on 17 October as the National Museum of Taiwan Literature and becomes a national monument.

認識景點

About the place

州廳的誕生Birth of the hall

建築師森山松之助：總督府營繕課建築師，也參與設計臺北的總統府、臺中州廳等。 1916 年遷入：1913 年上樑，1916 年 5 月 20 日辦公室從清代巡道署遷入。 兩翼後來才加上：一開始只有正門和衛塔，1918 到 1920 年間才增建兩翼。 臺南州：1920 年改制為臺南州，範圍包含今天的臺南、嘉義、雲林。

Architect Moriyama Matsunosuke: He also worked on the Presidential Office Building in Taipei. Moving in, 1916: On May 20, 1916, the offices moved in from an old Qing building. Wings added later: At first there was only the center and towers. The wings came between 1918 and 1920. Tainan Prefecture: From 1920, Tainan Prefecture covered today's Tainan, Chiayi and Yunlin.

圓環旁的地標：它位在大正公園（今湯德章紀念公園）南側，許多官署圍繞在附近。

Landmark on the roundabout: It stands on the south side of today's Tang Te-chang Memorial Park.

屋頂、圓頂與紅磚Roof, domes and red brick

馬薩式屋頂：源自法國的雙斜度屋頂；原本鋪著紋樣石板瓦和銅瓦。馬薩式屋頂又叫法式屋頂、孟莎式屋頂，每一面有兩段斜坡：下面陡、上面緩，屋頂裡就多出一層可以住人的閣樓。它因 17 世紀法國建築師芒薩爾（François Mansart）而得名，在巴黎很常見。據說這樣多出來的一層可以算成閣樓，少繳一些稅；不過歷史學家認為，更重要的原因是巴黎限制房屋高度時只量到屋簷，屋頂裡的閣樓不算。 衛塔圓頂：正面兩側各有一座衛塔，塔頂是圓頂。 三根一組的柱子：門廊四個角落各以三根塔斯干柱撐起。 老虎窗與牛眼窗：屋簷開了老虎窗和圓形牛眼窗，可通風也能裝飾。

Mansard roof: A French-style roof, first covered with slate and copper tiles. It has two slopes on each side: steep below and gentle above. That makes room for an extra attic floor. It is named after the French architect François Mansart, and it is common in Paris. It is said people built it this way so the extra floor counted as an attic, and they paid less tax. But historians think a Paris height rule mattered more: the height was measured only to the edge of the roof, so the attic inside did not count. Domed guard towers: Two guard towers stand at the front, each with a dome on top. Columns in threes: At each corner of the porch, three Tuscan columns stand together. Dormer and bull's-eye windows: Small dormer and round bull's-eye windows let air into the roof.

老虎窗：是從斜屋頂上凸出來的小窗，像屋頂上的一間小房子，有自己的小屋頂和兩面小牆，窗戶是直立的。它讓閣樓多出可以站直的空間。直接平貼在斜屋頂上的叫「屋頂窗」，它不會多出空間，但朝著天空，光線更多。 紅磚與洗石子：外觀用紅磚、石材和洗石子，紅白相間很醒目。

Dormer window: A dormer window sticks out from a sloping roof, like a tiny house on the roof, with its own little roof and walls. Its window stands upright, so the attic gets more room to stand. A roof window lies flat in the slope instead. It adds no room, but it faces the sky and lets in more light. Red brick and white bands: Red brick, stone and white bands give the hall its bright face.

戰火與重生War and rebirth

臺南大空襲：1945 年 3 月 1 日，美軍燒夷彈擊中州廳，屋頂與木構造幾乎全毀。 只剩外牆：矗立，荒廢了大約四年。 空軍進駐：1949 年空軍供應司令部進駐，屋頂只簡單修成兩坡式斜屋頂。 臺南市政府：1969 年移交臺南市政府，辦公 28 年，1997 年 10 月 1 日遷往安平。

The Tainan air raid: On March 1, 1945, incendiary bombs nearly destroyed the roof and wooden parts. Only the walls stood: Only the outer walls stood, and the hall lay in ruins for about four years. The Air Force moves in: In 1949 the Air Force moved in and gave it a simple sloping roof. Tainan City Hall: From 1969, it was city hall for 28 years, until the move to Anping in 1997.

修復與古蹟：1997 年開始修復，2002 年底完工，恢復日治時期外觀；1998 年列為市定古蹟，2003 年升格國定古蹟。 新舊相連：新建築蓋在舊州廳後方的中庭範圍，比舊建築矮，用廊道和遮棚相連；全館地上兩層、地下三層。 2003 年開館：2003 年 10 月 17 日開館，紀念 1921 年同一天成立的臺灣文化協會。

Restoration and protection: Restoration began in 1997 and brought back the old look. It became a national monument in 2003. Old and new, side by side: A new building rises in the old courtyard, lower than the hall, joined by walkways. Opening day, 2003: It opened on October 17, 2003, the birthday of the Taiwan Cultural Association.

文學的家A home for literature

原住民族口傳文學：原住民族的神話、傳說和歌謠，靠口耳一代代流傳。 古典漢詩：十七世紀沈光文在臺灣組織東吟詩社，是早期的詩社。 臺語與客語：臺灣文學也用臺語（河洛話）和客語書寫、吟唱。 日文與華語：日治時期許多作家用日文創作，戰後則多用華語。

Indigenous oral literature: Indigenous myths, legends and songs were passed down by word of mouth. Classical Chinese poetry: In the 1600s, Shen Guangwen started one of Taiwan's early poetry clubs. Taiwanese and Hakka: Taiwan literature is also written and sung in Taiwanese and Hakka. Japanese and Mandarin: Many writers used Japanese in the colonial era, and Mandarin after the war.

賴和：被尊為「臺灣新文學之父」。 手稿：館藏有書刊、手稿、書信、照片、書畫和文物。

Lai He: He is honored as the father of Taiwan's new literature. manuscript: The collection holds books, manuscripts, letters, photos and calligraphy.

實景照片

Photos on site

州廳正面 The front of the hall

正面中央是綠色的馬薩式屋頂，上面有小小的老虎窗。紅磚牆配上白色的石材與洗石子，讓州廳的臉非常明亮。州廳由日本建築師森山松之助設計。

A green Mansard roof sits above the middle of the hall, with small dormer windows on top. Red brick and white bands make its face bright. The hall was designed by the Japanese architect Moriyama Matsunosuke.

入口門廊 The entrance porch

門廊的角落，三根托斯坎柱站在一起。門廊上方寫著「國立臺灣文學館」。

At the corners of the porch, three Tuscan columns stand together. The sign above the porch says National Museum of Taiwan Literature.

圓頂衛塔 A domed guard tower

從斜角看，轉角是一座圓弧形的衛塔，塔頂戴著圓頂。州廳在 1916 年完工；1945 年空襲燒毀屋頂，修復後在 2003 年成為國立臺灣文學館。

From this side, you can see a round guard tower with a dome on top. The hall was finished in 1916. After a 1945 air raid and a long restoration, it became a literature museum in 2003.

舊建築的立體模型 A model of the old building

館內有一座 1:100 的立體模型，讓我們看清這棟國定古蹟的全貌。紅磚建造的主體建築在日治時期 1916 年完工：綠色的馬薩式屋頂、紅磚牆面，底部是灰白色牆面和仿石磚基座。外觀均勻、左右對稱，屬於西洋歷史式樣建築。從上面看，整棟建築像一個大大的「V」字。

Inside the museum is a 1:100 model of the old building, so you can see the whole national monument at once. The red-brick main building was finished in 1916, during Japanese rule. It has a green Mansard roof, red-brick walls, and a pale base made to look like stone. It is even and balanced on both sides, in a Western historical style. From above, the building looks like a big letter V.
